description: This file defines the GatewayTimeoutInvalidException class, a specific runtime exception used to indicate invalid timeout configurations in HTTP calls within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes static methods for constructing instances from messages or JSON, a builder class for mutable construction, and implements interfaces for exception handling.

classes.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException
classes.description: A final class representing a specific runtime exception indicating an invalid timeout in HTTP calls, with static factory methods and an inner builder class.

classes.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException.Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe mutable builder class for constructing instances of GatewayTimeoutInvalidException with fluent API.

methods.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException.newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with specified timeout parameters.

methods.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException.fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an exception with a provided message and headers.

methods.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException.fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an exception based on a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: GatewayTimeoutInvalidException.setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a copy of the exception with updated headers.

methods.name: Builder.doBuild
methods.description: Builds the exception instance using the accumulated fields.
